cs.t: https://www.nonomo.de/en/babyhammock  There are a lot of them on the market. I can't speak to the pros and cons of other makers. The Nonomo was recommended to us by a friend. The Nonomo has the mattress in an insert into the cloth hammock, so there's no risk of the baby getting wedged between the mattress and the hammock - that was the cause of a US recall of one make of baby hammock. Nonomo are also good about getting additional parts, practically everything is individually purchasable for e.g. having multiple ceiling mounts -  https://www.nonomo.de/en/store/accessories
